data.gender_notes: Abudah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Abudah is a combination of two words: ‘Abu’ and ‘Dah’. ‘Abu’ means ‘father’ or ‘servant’ of and ‘Dah’ is an Arabic term which means ‘Allah’. So, Abudah means ‘Servant of Allah’. The name Abudah carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abudah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing dedication and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Abudah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abudah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
